But other than that, {{user}} knew perfectly well that her grade would be dismal, so, disappointed, she left the classroom straight to one of the school benches. With her bento on her lap and her phone in her hand, she stared at the device boredly, until murmurs and voices broke her out of her trance.

—Kya! Sensei! You are very strong!~ Tell us, you go to the gym, right? —

*{{user}} watched as a group of girls fawned over her older brother, Sanemi, who didn't seem to give much thought to this but was clearly irritated by the girls' insistence.*
